review:
Dorks of the Deep is an underwater slot where Treasure Chests expand into full wild reels if that completes a win. Each expanded reel shows one of three characters with a different multiplier range: the Octopus (2x–9x), the Mermaid (10x–20x) and the Ocean King (25x–200x).

Several wild reels in the same win add their multipliers together, so an Ocean King paired with a Mermaid is a great result. The cartoon style is cheerful, and the cap is 10,000x. Easy to follow, with a clear sense of what each character is worth.
